title: Fix excessive opening enemy density
description: Opening wave currently refills to 25 alive at 0:00 and pressure-spawns too aggressively, producing too many enemies around 15 seconds. Keep the 30-minute curve uncondensed but add a calmer opening ramp and correct pressure spawn rate.
design: Design source consulted: PAGEBOUND_CODEX_GDD_v1_5.md section 38, design/gdd/run-director-and-finite-spawning.md, latest user screenshot/clarification. notes: Root cause: opening wave uses min_alive 25 immediately at 0:00, then pressure spawns use target_kills_per_second * spawn_buffer_seconds, producing about 4 enemies/sec before player kill rate exists. Fix plan: keep 30-minute XP/spawn curve uncondensed; add 0:00-1:00 opening min-alive ramp 8 -> 25; preserve 5:00/15:00/30:00 curve anchors; make pressure spawn rate report and spawn cadence match target kills/sec instead of 4x; keep 30:00 target 10 kills/sec, min alive 320, max alive 350.

comments.author: seanlongcc
comments.text: Draft/acquisition canon from grill session: normal level-up drafts show 3 cards. Each card rolls 90% upgrade / 10% new gear. Gear subroll is 50% new weapon / 50% new item, with redirect to the other gear type if chosen type is full and other slot type is open. Upgrade subroll is 50% weapon upgrade / 50% item upgrade, with redirect to other upgrade type if chosen type has no legal upgrade. Specific selection within legal category is uniform random. Reroll exact duplicate target+action cards within one draft. New gear always enters at level 1. Upgrade cards always grant +1 level. Page Event rewards use the same normal draft, with one extra constraint: if any weapon/item slot is open, at least one card is new gear; forced gear also uses 50/50 weapon/item with redirect. Overflow starts only when no normal legal cards exist and offers global +5% stat crumbs. Current scope has no elite/chest rewards, no Pagecraft modifiers, no utility rewards, no event evolutions, no pity, and no static level-gated weapon acquisition. Crownless echo/boss gives no in-run draft in first exemplar.

Dog has world fetch feedback plus an always-visible small pet icon near the bottom-left level badge that pulses/mirrors fetch feedback; pet is not a loadout slot.
